notes: Fresh process per run, normal desktop load, AC power, no concurrent task builds or benchmarks. No background application was stopped.
This is an additional workload gate after the frequent-switch policy change, not a rerun of the failed repeated-switch workload.
Both variants use their own frozen uninstrumented Release executable, DLL and kernel source; both use identical resources and events.
Paired short cases alternate execution order. Long-stage baseline samples use 1024 calls and must not be pooled with 22500-call candidate rounds.
The candidate failed in distance-ramps at zero-based measured call 3949 (benchmark call 3981 including 32 warmup calls). Maximum 5.6484 ms exceeds 512/96000 seconds.
No stage profiler ran, so the single fixed-room spike is not attributed to EQ GPU waiting or desktop contention.
No remaining motion rounds, macOS performance matrix, or audio-device playback integration were run after the gate failure.
Prior frequent-switch measurements and prior validation outcomes remain unchanged.
